gaps.sentence: She goes to ___ school by bus every morning.
gaps.explanation: 'Go to school/work/bed/church' (as participant) takes no article.

gaps.sentence: ___ Netherlands borders both Belgium and Germany.
He left ___ school at sixteen and went straight into a job.
gaps.explanation: Leave school (finish education) takes no article.

gaps.sentence: He was offered ___ job in the human resources department.
gaps.explanation: 'A job' — first mention of one of many possible jobs. Note: 'in human resources' takes no article.

gaps.sentence: ___ Himalayas are among the youngest mountains on Earth.
gaps.explanation: Ranges like 'the Himalayas' take 'the'; single peaks take no article.

gaps.sentence: She's studying history at ___ University of Vienna.
gaps.explanation: University names with of-phrases take the: the University of Vienna.

gaps.sentence: ___ Alps attract skiers from all over the world.
gaps.explanation: Mountain ranges take 'the' (the Alps), but single peaks take no article (Everest).
